answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities: each agent pays a 50-credit fee, burned on entry, for a marble token. A wharf-side check demands a distinct funding source per fee, so one operator cannot reuse one pot for many tokens. Any fable of free identities collapses, since unpaid work earns nothing. Faking 100 identities costs 5,000 credits for one 400-credit reward, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
